title: A core with loops
bestSource: The eight H’s have at most 12 neighbouring pairs (a 2×2×2 cube), and 4 of them are consecutive in the string. Exhaustive search agrees (scripts/hp-optimum.ts).
intro: Four HH pairs joined by PP loops. An optimal fold packs the eight H’s into a cube and keeps every P outside it.
hint: Each HH pair is one edge of the cube. A PP loop leaves the cube and comes back next to where it left.
